---
Title: "Calculating Marginal State Occupancy Probabilities from a Bayesian Markov Model"
---

This document demonstrates how to simulate patient trajectories and calculate State Occupancy Probabilities (SOPs) from a second-order Bayesian Markov model fit with the blrm function. The workflow is designed to handle posterior draws efficiently and save results to disk to prevent memory overflow.

## Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(arrow)
library(rmsb)
library(zoo)
library(Hmisc)
```

## Fit model to use

```{r}
df_ypprev <- read_parquet("./data/hosp_long_weeks_two_lags.parquet") |> 
    mutate(
        tx = factor(tx),
        ecog_fstcnt = factor(ecog_fstcnt, ordered = FALSE),
        y = ordered(y)
    ) |> 
      select(pat_id, tx, y, yprev, ypprev, week, ecog_fstcnt, diagnosis, age, gender, albumin, c_reactive_protein)

d <- df_ypprev
```

```{r}
Sys.setenv(RSTUDIO = 1)
  
  dd <- datadist(d)
  options(datadist = 'dd')
  options(mc.cores = 4)
  
fit_second_order <- blrm(
  y ~ tx + rcs(week, 4) + yprev + ypprev + week %ia% yprev + week %ia% ypprev + ecog_fstcnt + albumin + cluster(pat_id),
  data = d,
  refresh = 5,
  iter = 2000,
  chains = 4,
  seed = 1234,
  method = "sampling",
  backend = "cmdstan"
)
Sys.setenv(RSTUDIO = 0)
```
```{r}
convert_to_states <- function(cumulative_probs) {
    if (!is.matrix(cumulative_probs)) {
        cumulative_probs <- t(as.matrix(cumulative_probs))
    }
    
    n_rows <- nrow(cumulative_probs)
    n_states <- ncol(cumulative_probs) + 1
    
    # Initialize the matrix for state probabilities
    state_probs <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_rows, ncol = n_states)
    
    # P(y=1)
    state_probs[, 1] <- 1 - cumulative_probs[, 1]
    
    # P(y=2) to P(y=4)
    for (j in 2:(n_states - 1)) {
        state_probs[, j] <- cumulative_probs[, j - 1] - cumulative_probs[, j]
    }
    
    # P(y=5)
    state_probs[, n_states] <- cumulative_probs[, n_states - 1]
    
    return(state_probs)
}

predict_markov_sops_blrm <- function(model,
                                     baseline_data,
                                     n_states,
                                     times,
                                     time_var_name,
                                     yprev_name,
                                     ypprev_name,
                                     absorbing_state = NULL) {

  # --- 1. Setup ---
  pat_id <- baseline_data$pat_id
  all_states <- factor(1:n_states)
  first_pred_time <- min(times)
  iter_times <- times[times > first_pred_time]
  n_cats <- n_states - 1
  all_draws_results <- list()


  initial_pred_data <- as.data.frame(baseline_data)
  initial_pred_data[[time_var_name]] <- first_pred_time

  pred_obj_initial <- predict(model, newdata = initial_pred_data, type = "fitted")
  draws_initial <- attr(pred_obj_initial, "draws")
  pred_first_step_cum_all_draws <- matrix(draws_initial, ncol = n_cats, byrow = TRUE)
  
  n_draws <- nrow(pred_first_step_cum_all_draws)
  
  # Convert initial cumulative probabilities to state probabilities for all draws
  pi_first_step_all_draws <- convert_to_states(pred_first_step_cum_all_draws)

  transition_preds_by_time <- list()
  
  y_name <- all.vars(formula(model))[1]
  static_covars <- setdiff(names(baseline_data), c("pat_id", y_name, yprev_name, ypprev_name, time_var_name))

for (t in iter_times) {
    grid_list <- list(all_states, all_states)
    names(grid_list) <- c(ypprev_name, yprev_name)
    newdata_t <- expand.grid(grid_list)
    newdata_t[[time_var_name]] <- t
    
    if (length(static_covars) > 0) {
        newdata_t <- cbind(newdata_t, baseline_data[, static_covars, drop = FALSE])
    }
    
    model_predict_rows_bool <- rep(TRUE, nrow(newdata_t))
    if (!is.null(absorbing_state)) {
      model_predict_rows_bool <- (newdata_t[[yprev_name]] != absorbing_state) & (newdata_t[[ypprev_name]] != absorbing_state)
    }

    # **CORRECTED LOGIC**: Extract draws and reshape for multiple newdata rows
    pred_obj_transient <- predict(model, 
                                  newdata = newdata_t[model_predict_rows_bool, ], 
                                  type = "fitted")
    draws_transient <- attr(pred_obj_transient, "draws")
    
    # Reshape the vector. The number of rows is n_draws, and R infers the number of columns.
    pred_transient_cum_all_draws <- matrix(draws_transient, nrow = n_draws, byrow = TRUE)

    transition_preds_by_time[[as.character(t)]] <- list(
      newdata_t = newdata_t,
      model_predict_rows_bool = model_predict_rows_bool,
      predictions = pred_transient_cum_all_draws
    )
  }

  # --- 3. Main Loop: Iterate over each posterior draw ---
  for (d in 1:n_draws) {
    pi_first_step_d <- pi_first_step_all_draws[d, ]
    occupancy_probs_d <- list()
    occupancy_probs_d[[as.character(first_pred_time)]] <- pi_first_step_d
    joint_prob_prev_d <- matrix(0, nrow = n_states, ncol = n_states)
    yprev_state <- baseline_data[[yprev_name]]
    joint_prob_prev_d[yprev_state, ] <- pi_first_step_d
    
    for (t in iter_times) {
      t_preds <- transition_preds_by_time[[as.character(t)]]
      transition_probs_t_d <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(t_preds$newdata_t), ncol = n_states)

      if (!is.null(absorbing_state)) {
        absorbing_rows <- t_preds$newdata_t[[yprev_name]] == absorbing_state
        transition_probs_t_d[absorbing_rows, absorbing_state] <- 1
      }

      if (any(t_preds$model_predict_rows_bool)) {
        pred_vector_d <- t_preds$predictions[d, ]
        n_pred_rows <- sum(t_preds$model_predict_rows_bool)
        
        pred_matrix_d <- matrix(pred_vector_d, nrow = n_pred_rows, ncol = n_cats, byrow = TRUE)
        pred_transient_d <- convert_to_states(pred_matrix_d)
        
        transition_probs_t_d[t_preds$model_predict_rows_bool, ] <- pred_transient_d
      }
      
      initial_array <- array(t(transition_probs_t_d), dim = c(n_states, n_states, n_states))
      transition_array <- aperm(initial_array, c(2, 3, 1))
      
      joint_prob_new_d <- matrix(0, nrow = n_states, ncol = n_states)
      for (k in 1:n_states) {
        T_k <- transition_array[, , k]
        joint_prob_new_d[, k] <- colSums(T_k * joint_prob_prev_d)
      }
      
      pi_t_d <- colSums(joint_prob_new_d)
      occupancy_probs_d[[as.character(t)]] <- pi_t_d
      joint_prob_prev_d <- joint_prob_new_d
    } 
    
    final_probs_d <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, occupancy_probs_d))
    colnames(final_probs_d) <- paste0("State_", 1:n_states)
    
    final_probs_d$time <- as.integer(rownames(final_probs_d))
    final_probs_d$draw <- d
    final_probs_d$pat_id <- pat_id
    
    all_draws_results[[d]] <- final_probs_d
  } 
  
  # --- 4. Final Combination and Return ---
  final_df <- do.call(rbind, all_draws_results)
  rownames(final_df) <- NULL
  final_df <- final_df[, c("pat_id", "draw", "time", paste0("State_", 1:n_states))]
  
  return(final_df)
}
```
